description: R10 task 5 (full audit, supersedes the earlier single-entry P2-12 ledger) -- OPTION 1 relative-delta ledger for docs/opsiq/ux/OWNER_FEATURE_PRESERVATION_BASELINE.json. Every numeric leaf field in the generated baseline (ownerPageRoutes[].componentTreeFileCount, cockpitExternalFeeds[].callSiteCount, businessContextClassificationCounts.*) was diffed between a fresh generation at the current main tip (548908a8501e45a587b90fffeaa286fcfbc7d6a9, which this branch fully contains -- merge-base(main,HEAD) === main's own tip, so there is no unrelated main drift left unaccounted for) and a fresh generation at this branch's HEAD. Each entry records, for one field this branch changed, the accepted main baseline value at the SHA named, this branch's OWN delta from its own code changes across the full branch history (merge-base(main,branch)..HEAD), and the resulting expected committed value (acceptedMainValue + branchDelta). The committed baseline's own field must always equal acceptedMainValue + branchDelta -- never a bare absolute number carried over from a stale generation. src/__tests__/governance/preservation-relative-delta.test.ts proves this relationship holds for every entry, using a synthetic accepted-main value in addition to the real one, so the test cannot pass merely because today's numbers happen to agree. No entry here reflects main's own independent drift alone (branchDelta === 0 entries are out of scope and intentionally absent) -- every entry's branchDelta is non-zero and traceable to a specific branch-owned source change.
